title: HB1314 (2022 Regular): prohibit the personal possession of a loaded firearm while in possession of cannabis or cannabis products and to provide a penalty therefor.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (South Dakota) (gun-policy Stage 5, South Dakota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official South Dakota text (Introduced, 2022-02-02; official copy, https://mylrc.sdlegislature.gov/api/Documents/232152.pdf (sdlegislature.gov DocumentId 232152, BillId 23435))
provenance.note: Introduced text, 2022-02-02. Section 2 (SDCL 22-14-7) struck the old subdivision (3), loaded firearm while intoxicated, and recast the rest as a list; the intoxication offence reappears in Section 3.  The long SDCL 22-1-2 definitions in Section 1 are existing law except the new 'loaded firearm' item. No passage vote recorded.

operative_text:
Section 1 (SDCL 22-1-2): "Loaded firearm," any firearm that contains a cartridge, shell, or projectile in the chamber, including any chamber in the cylinder of a revolver;
Section 3 (new section in SDCL ch. 22-14): A person is guilty of a Class 1 misdemeanor if the person is in personal possession of a loaded firearm, as defined in § 22-1-2, while: (1) Intoxicated; or (2) In possession of cannabis or cannabis products, as defined in § 34-20G-1.
